generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should have successfully executed contracts/works for providing skilled/Technical manpower for Electrical or Mechanical maintenance/operational works at Hydro power stations/ Thermal power stations / Power utility in India. In proof of the above, the intending bidder shall upload scanned copy of single work order with relevant work done certificate of any one work of value not less than Rs.8.56 Lakhs carried out within last five financial years (i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24,2024-25, and 2025-26). Cost of completed works of previous years will be given 10 percent of simple weightage per year to bring them to current year price level

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder should have achieved at least 2 financial years a minimum annual turnover of Rs.17.13 Lakhs during last five financial years (i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25, and 2025-26). In proof, turnover certificate OR Profit and Loss statements duly certified by chartered accountant shall be furnished. Financial Turnover of previous years will be given 10 percent of simple weightage per year to bring them to current year price level
